record.original_question: For integers q >= p >= r >= 2, how can one characterize the graphs in G(m, theta_{r,p,q}) that have the largest spectral radius?

evidence.quote: Problem 10 (Li, Zhao and Zou [17], 2025). How can we characterize the graphs among G(m, thetar,p,q) having the largest spectral radius for q >= p >= r >= 2?
As products of Theorem 3.48, Li, Liu and Zhang [22] solved Problem 7 with a quite different method from that of Liu et al. [27], and solved Problem 10, Conjecture 3.39 completely.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For integers q ≥ p ≥ r ≥ 2, the theta graph θ_{r,p,q} is the simple graph obtained by taking two distinct vertices u and v and joining them by three internally disjoint paths of lengths r, p, and q respectively. Given a graph F, a graph G is called F-free if G contains no subgraph isomorphic to F, and G(m, F) denotes the family of all F-free simple graphs with exactly m edges and no isolated vertices. The spectral radius of a graph G is the largest eigenvalue of its adjacency matrix.

Problem: For all integers q ≥ p ≥ r ≥ 2, characterize completely the graphs in G(m, θ_{r,p,q}) attaining the maximum spectral radius (for all sufficiently large m, identifying the unique extremal graph or the family of extremal graphs).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem, posed by Li, Zhao and Zou (2025) on characterizing the θ_{r,p,q}-free graphs of given size with maximum spectral radius, has been resolved. Subsequent work by Li, Liu and Zhang reportedly settled the general case, complementing earlier partial resolutions for specific subcases such as θ_{1,3,3}-free and θ_{2,2,3}-free graphs that appear in the recent literature.

status_evidence.title: The maximum spectral radius of θ1,3,3-free graphs with given size
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the maximum spectral radius of θ_{1,3,3}-free graphs with m edges, a special case of the broader θ_{r,p,q} extremal problem.
status_evidence.claim: Special cases of the θ_{r,p,q}-free spectral extremal problem have been resolved, indicating progress culminating in the general resolution.

status_evidence.title: The maximum spectral radius of θ_{2,2,3}-free graphs with given size
status_evidence.snippet: Determines the extremal graph maximizing the spectral radius among θ_{2,2,3}-free graphs of fixed size.
status_evidence.claim: Another subcase (r,p,q)=(2,2,3) has been solved, supporting that the general problem has been addressed.

status_evidence.title: Spectral extrema of graphs with fixed size: forbidden a fan graph, friendship graph or theta graph
status_evidence.snippet: Spectral extremal results for graphs forbidding theta graphs of given size.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work develops methods used to settle the general θ_{r,p,q} spectral extremal problem.
